newsitem.title: USA: Hvide Marine to offer 6 mln Class A shares.
newsitem.headline: Hvide Marine to offer 6 mln Class A shares.

text.p: Hvide Marine Inc said Monday it had filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission to offer up to six million Class A common shares.
Of the total, 3,822,728 shares will be offered by the company and 2,177,272 will be offered by stockholders, the filing said.
After the offering, outstanding Class A shares will total 13,358,630, and outstanding Class B shares will total 1,531,466 common, the filing said.
The company has granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option on up to 900,000 additional Class A shares.
The offering will be made through Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp and Howard, Weil, Labouisse, Friedrichs Inc.
Proceeds will be used to fund the balance of the cost of current acquitisions, to repay a portion of the company's debt, and for general corporate purposes.
Selling stockholders include the Clipper/Park HMI L.P. family trust with an offering of 818,034 shares, and Clipper/Hercules L.P. with an offer of 456,107 shares, the filing said.
Hvide, of Fort Lauderdale, Fla., provides marine support and transportation services primarily in the U.S. domestic trade and principally to the energy and chemical industries.
